svg.title: Instruction tuning teaches models to follow tasks
svg.desc: Instruction tuning fine-tunes a pretrained base model on instruction, optional input, and target output examples. It updates weights using cross-entropy on target output tokens; prompting alone makes no parameter update.

g.text: Instruction tuning teaches models to follow tasks
Supervised examples turn next-token prediction into natural-language task following.
Hold out task families to test instruction following on unseen tasks.
